title.zh: 联储将联邦基金目标区间上调至 3.75%–4.00%
title.en: Fed raises the federal-funds target range to 3.75%–4.00%

summary.zh: FOMC 以 12–0 投票加息 25 个基点，并称通胀仍偏高；这是政策事实，不单独预测后续利率路径或资产价格。
summary.en: The FOMC voted 12–0 for a 25-basis-point increase and said inflation remains elevated; this is a policy fact, not a standalone forecast of future rates or asset prices.

title.zh: 联储加息后美股收跌
title.en: US equities fall after the Fed rate increase

summary.zh: 报道记录了加息决定后的指数收盘表现；用于观察市场反应，不能直接推断观察名单公司的经营或盈利。
summary.en: Reporting on index closes after the rate decision; use it to observe market reaction, not directly infer watchlist-company operations or earnings.

title.zh: 科技股带动港股与内地市场走高
title.en: Technology shares lift Hong Kong and mainland markets

summary.zh: 恒指与科技指数收高；用于记录当日风险偏好，不替代对腾讯或泡泡玛特经营指标的验证。
summary.en: The Hang Seng and technology index closed higher; record the day's risk appetite without substituting it for operating evidence at Tencent or Pop Mart.

title.zh: DRAM 现货价格：DDR5 与 DDR4 8Gb 上涨、DDR4 16Gb 回落
title.en: DRAM spot pricing: DDR5 and DDR4 8Gb rise while DDR4 16Gb eases

summary.zh: 9 月 16 日报价显示产品间分化扩大；一日现货数据不能直接外推为合约价、HBM 盈利或 DRAM 基金回报。
summary.en: September 16 quotes showed wider product dispersion; one-day spot data cannot directly infer contract pricing, HBM profitability or DRAM ETF returns.

title.zh: 油价与债券市场继续施压美股
title.en: Oil and the bond market continue to pressure US equities

summary.zh: 报道记录了油价上行、10 年期美债收益率升至 5% 与美国股指走弱；用于观察风险偏好与折现率环境，不直接推断企业基本面。
summary.en: Reporting on higher oil, a 10-year Treasury yield at 5% and weaker US indexes; use it to observe risk appetite and the discount-rate backdrop, not directly infer company fundamentals.

title.zh: AI 硬件反弹未能抵消港股跌势
title.en: AI hardware rebound fails to offset Hong Kong losses

summary.zh: 恒指与科技指数下跌，腾讯逆势上涨；用于记录当日市场表现，不替代对腾讯或泡泡玛特经营指标的验证。
summary.en: The Hang Seng and tech index fell while Tencent rose; record the session without substituting it for operating evidence at Tencent or Pop Mart.

title.zh: Siri AI 开始提供英语 beta
title.en: Siri AI begins English beta availability

summary.zh: Apple 宣布新一代 Apple Intelligence 与 Siri AI 可用，英语 beta 当日开始；中国及部分地区的可用性受限，采用和商业化仍须后续数据验证。
summary.en: Apple announced availability of the next generation of Apple Intelligence and Siri AI, with the English beta beginning that day; China and some regional access are limited, and adoption plus monetization still require later evidence.

title.zh: DRAM 现货价格：DDR5 小幅上行、DDR4 局部回调
title.en: DRAM spot pricing: DDR5 modestly higher with selected DDR4 easing

summary.zh: 9 月 15 日报价显示 DDR5 16Gb 上涨，DDR4 8Gb 与 16Gb 小幅下跌；一日现货数据不能直接外推为合约价、HBM 盈利或 DRAM 基金回报。
summary.en: September 15 quotes showed DDR5 16Gb higher and DDR4 8Gb plus 16Gb modestly lower; one-day spot data cannot directly infer contract pricing, HBM profitability or DRAM ETF returns.

title.zh: 油价与 AI 风险偏好施压美股
title.en: Oil and AI risk appetite pressure US equities

summary.zh: 报道记录了油价、长端利率与 AI 相关股的单日市场压力；用于观察风险偏好，而非直接推断观察名单公司的收入或竞争力。
summary.en: Reporting on one-day market pressure from oil, long yields and AI-linked shares; use it to observe risk appetite, not directly infer watchlist-company revenue or competitiveness.

title.zh: DRAM 现货价格：DDR5 持平、DDR4 局部回调
title.en: DRAM spot pricing: DDR5 flat with selected DDR4 adjustments

summary.zh: 9 月 14 日报价显示 DDR5 与 DDR4 8Gb 持平、DDR4 16Gb 下调；这是一日现货观察，不能直接外推为合约价、HBM 盈利或 DRAM 基金回报。
summary.en: September 14 quotes showed flat DDR5 and DDR4 8Gb, with DDR4 16Gb lower; this one-day spot observation cannot directly infer contract pricing, HBM profitability or DRAM ETF returns.

title.zh: Samsung 与 ASML 扩展 High NA EUV 合作
title.en: Samsung and ASML expand High NA EUV collaboration

summary.zh: Samsung 计划到 2028 年将 High NA EUV 导入未来 DRAM 高量产。该披露是远期制造路线，不是已实现的产能、成本或行业供给变化。
summary.en: Samsung plans to introduce High NA EUV into future DRAM high-volume manufacturing by 2028. This is a long-term manufacturing roadmap, not realized capacity, cost or an industry-supply change.

title.zh: 美国 8 月消费者价格指数
title.en: US Consumer Price Index for August

summary.zh: 官方数据：CPI 同比上涨 3.4%，未经季调环比持平。用于观察通胀事实，不单独推断联储行动或资产价格。
summary.en: Official data: CPI rose 3.4% year over year and was unchanged month over month before seasonal adjustment. Use it for inflation facts, not standalone inferences about Fed action or asset prices.

title.zh: SK hynix Future Forum：AI 时代的内存系统讨论
title.en: SK hynix Future Forum: memory systems for the AI era

summary.zh: 厂商讨论多智能体与长任务的容量、带宽瓶颈，以及 HBM、DRAM、CXL、SSD 的系统级组合；不等同于订单或收入披露。
summary.en: A vendor discussion of capacity and bandwidth bottlenecks in multi-agent and long-running tasks, and system-level combinations of HBM, DRAM, CXL and SSD; it is not an order or revenue disclosure.

title.zh: DRAM 现货价格：DDR5 持平、部分 DDR4 下调
title.en: DRAM spot pricing: DDR5 flat and selected DDR4 quotes lower

summary.zh: 日度现货数据用于观察产品间流动性与价格分化；不能直接外推为合约价、HBM 盈利或 DRAM 基金回报。
summary.en: Use daily spot data to observe liquidity and price segmentation across products; do not extrapolate directly to contract pricing, HBM profitability or DRAM ETF returns.

title.zh: TrendForce：iPhone Duo 的折叠屏市场估计
title.en: TrendForce: iPhone Duo foldable-market estimate

summary.zh: 机构预计 iPhone Duo 2026 年出货约 500 万部、占折叠屏市场 24.8%；这是外部预测，需用预订、供给和 Apple 后续披露验证。
summary.en: The firm estimates roughly 5 million 2026 iPhone Duo shipments and 24.8% foldable-market share; this external forecast needs validation from preorders, supply and later Apple disclosures.

title.zh: DRAM 现货价格：部分 DDR5 报价下修、交易清淡
title.en: DRAM spot pricing: selected DDR5 quotes ease amid quiet trading

summary.zh: 每日现货数据反映有限询价与局部报价调整；用于观察流动性和结构，不应用于直接推断合约价、HBM 盈利或 DRAM 基金回报。
summary.en: Daily spot data show limited inquiries and selected quote adjustments; use them for liquidity and segmentation, not direct inferences about contract pricing, HBM profits or DRAM ETF returns.

title.zh: Apple 发布首款折叠 iPhone Duo
title.en: Apple introduces its first foldable iPhone, iPhone Duo

summary.zh: 官方产品披露确认折叠形态、A20 Pro 与 Apple Intelligence 路径；预订与发售后的需求、组合和毛利率仍须验证。
summary.en: Official product disclosure confirms the foldable form factor, A20 Pro and Apple Intelligence path; demand, mix and margin evidence must follow preorder and availability.

title.zh: 微软、AFT 与 UFT 发布学校 AI 安全与隐私标准
title.en: Microsoft, AFT and UFT announce school AI safety and privacy standard

summary.zh: 可被学校纳入客户协议的 AI 治理框架；用于观察公共教育采购条件，不直接推断 Azure 或 Copilot 收入。
summary.en: An AI-governance framework that schools can incorporate into customer agreements; observe public-education procurement conditions without inferring Azure or Copilot revenue.

title.zh: DDR4 上涨、DDR5 需求有限的存储现货更新
title.en: Memory spot update: DDR4 rises while DDR5 demand remains limited

summary.zh: 行业资料显示 DDR4 的局部订单推动价格，但 DDR5 采购与 NAND 需求仍偏弱；用来跟踪结构性分化，而非单一价格趋势。
summary.en: Industry data show selected DDR4 orders lifting prices while DDR5 procurement and NAND demand remain weak; use it to track segmentation, not a single price trend.

title.zh: Google Cloud 与 Accenture 扩展 Gemini Enterprise 交付
title.en: Google Cloud and Accenture expand Gemini Enterprise delivery

summary.zh: 合作方宣布新的企业 AI 业务组和前置部署工程师团队；用于跟踪企业交付网络，而非直接推断收入。
summary.en: The partners announced an enterprise-AI business group and forward-deployed-engineer workforce; track delivery reach without inferring revenue directly.

title.zh: Micron FY26 Q3：存储器在 AI 时代的收入与现金流验证
title.en: Micron FY26 Q3: revenue and cash-flow evidence for memory in the AI era

summary.zh: 一手业绩披露与电话会材料；用于检查 HBM、服务器 DRAM、NAND 与长期供货安排。
summary.en: Primary earnings disclosure and call materials covering HBM, server DRAM, NAND and long-term supply arrangements.

title.zh: DRAM 基金：方法、持仓与风险披露
title.en: DRAM ETF: methodology, holdings and risk disclosure

summary.zh: 基金官方页；查看实际持仓、费用、风险与组合是否仍符合“存储器权益”这一研究假设。
summary.en: Official fund page for actual holdings, fees and risk disclosures; use it to check whether the portfolio still matches the memory-equity thesis.

title.zh: AI 如何改变 DRAM 供需：行业访谈
title.en: How AI is changing DRAM supply and demand: industry interview

summary.zh: 外部分析资料，适合建立问题清单；不作为单独的事实来源或交易结论。
summary.en: External analysis useful for forming questions; not a standalone source of facts or a trading conclusion.
